cmd:
echo "=== git ls-files data/forecast_analysis_gemini* data/blocks_gemini ==="
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
git ls-files data/forecast_analysis_gemini.json data/forecast_analysis_gemini.mp3 data/blocks_gemini | head -20
echo
echo "=== .gitignore relevant lines ==="
grep -i "gemini\|blocks\|forecast" .gitignore
echo
echo "=== file mtimes ==="
ls -la data/forecast_analysis_gemini.json data/forecast_analysis_gemini.mp3 data/blocks_gemini 2>&1 | head -10
echo
echo "=== gemini json content (head) ==="
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/forecast_analysis_gemini.json')); print('changed=',d.get('changed')); print('pending=',d.get('pending')); print('generated_at=',d.get('generated_at') or d.get('generated_time'))"
echo
echo "=== git status full ==="
git status --short | grep -i "gemini\|forecast\|blocks"
echo
echo "=== last vps_ai_pipeline manual run: check journalctl/log if any ==="
find /var/log -iname "*ai*" 2>/dev/null
find /opt/weather-pipeline -iname "*.log" 2>/dev/null
